diagnostic.scope: Yokohama childbenefit unsealed official original PDF only, fixed partial field GT with no-input pages2/3, existing f53 and d4 raw DTOs, existing evaluator-v3 code and manifest/selected input metadata. Exactly the new8 scorable FP positions. No new scoring, browser, OCR, generator, reserved, held, or old sealed payload access; no product/GT/scorer/raw/source edits. Original PDF pages2/3 rendered once at100dpi and visually inspected.
diagnostic.conclusion: The new8 are printed explanation graphics/lettering misdetected through geometry-to-underline allocation, not legitimate source answer allocations newly found. Seven tiny boxes come from closed black glyph contours sharing paragraph MCIDs; the eighth is a closed printed underline Artifact in a worked-example callout. The risk was already present in generic geometric inference and is now exposed by accepting these additional short spans. No raster OCR/fineRaster path is involved.
diagnostic.whyQuestionsRemain: Each is non-native, export allowed, readOnly=false, role=unknown, kind=checkbox/text, mappingState=needs-review rather than rejected, so evaluator-v3 questionCandidate(line29) treats it as a question. The existing inferFields logic detects only specific no-input/sample text contained within an individual candidate frame and does not consume the fixed GT no-input page classification. The sample headings and explained glyph lettering lie outside the tiny allocations or are path outlines; the default label/nearby footer label makes no office/example role. Existing GT is retained and therefore properly counts these as errors.
diagnostic.diagnosticOnlyBoundary: No source sentence, geometry, threshold, or GT was adjusted to match predictions. Other eight public documents and all TRAIN/held documents were not inspected for this diagnosis; their reported invariance comes from the parent task, not this report. Product code may concurrently be edited by root; this report pins the immutable existing DTOs/source/evaluator and does not claim a product-source snapshot.

For path top coordinates, y_raw=pdfplumber_page.bbox[3]-top+MediaBox.yMin. x values already use the raw x domain. Pypdf original text matrix is the independent cross-check.
